title: Prosecutors allege British woman ‘trying to find someone who would kill her’ lured to US and murdered
summary_full: Sonia Exelby’s disappearance sparked an international search. The accused man, Dwain Hall, denies murdering herProsecutors in Ocala, Florida, have been laying out an extraordinary criminal case against Dwain C Hall, an auto repair and tow truck driver accused of kidnapping and murdering Sonia Exelby, of Portsmouth, England.Prosecutors allege that Hall lured Exelby to the US before killing her in October last year and burying her body in a shallow grave in Marion Oaks. Hall has pleaded not guilty to the charges. Continue reading...
